verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence that a Trello mobile app exists is a single mention of a mobile-specific feature (camera text scanning). There is no vendor claim of feature parity with desktop. Hands-on community feedback says the iPhone app is "very far from their web interface" and much less usable, though that report is old. missing for 10: documented native iOS/Android apps, any first-party claim or evidence of desktop feature parity, recent independent corroboration of mobile completeness.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality

citations.quote: Scan text with your camera on mobile
